exposure: Mothers who received oxytocin during labor
Mothers who did not receive oxytocin during labor
cohort: 720 pregnant mothers at term who presented in labor and their newborn babies at Mulago National Referral Hospital
finding: Maternal-fetal factors significantly associated with high umbilical artery lactate levels included: baby's sex, mother's gravidity, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, and oxytocin administration during labor.
